answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk identity forgery. Each epoch offers only 100 slots, a small oasis: one costs a 50 POA deposit, a jade token forfeited if the slot sits idle. A willow cutting roots only in real soil; a slot pays only when its holder finishes real work, returning the deposit plus 30 POA. 1,000 fake identities burn 50,000 POA for 30,000 POA of rewards, a 20,000 POA loss. Honest agents pay once and keep the full reward.
